usage: reaction class evidence only; NOT experimentally validated recipe and no numeric recommendations

references.title: EDC/NHS activation mechanism of polymethacrylic acid: anhydride versus NHS-ester
references.scope: Mechanistic study on polymer carboxyl groups and side pathways; NOT experimental validation of peptide head-to-tail cyclization.

references.title: 2-Chlorotrityl chloride resin. Studies on anchoring of Fmoc-amino acids and peptide cleavage
references.scope: Specific 2-CTC loading and mild cleavage of protected fragments; not a guarantee for every protecting group.

references.title: Influence of solid support, solvent and coupling reagent on the head-to-tail cyclization of resin-bound peptides
references.scope: On-resin comparison; documents oligomerization and racemization concerns, not direct proof for solution protocols.

references.title: An improved method for the solution cyclization of peptides under pseudo-high dilution conditions
references.scope: Solution cyclization and intermolecular side products; concentration alone does not predict yield.

references.title: Head-to-tail cyclization of side chain-protected linear peptides to recapitulate genetically-encoded cyclized peptides
references.scope: Evidence for side-chain-protected linear precursor strategy, not for arbitrary reagent ratios or sequences.

references.title: Fmoc-based synthesis of disulfide-rich cyclic peptides
references.scope: 2-CTC, protected peptide solution cyclization, then side-chain deprotection and disulfide oxidation on specific targets.

references.title: Minimizing HCN in DIC/Oxyma-Mediated Amide Bond-Forming Reactions
references.scope: Reported HCN in DIC/Oxyma reactions in DMF; mitigation studies do not establish generic safe use.

references.title: Amide Formation: Choosing the Safer Carbodiimide in Combination with OxymaPure to Avoid HCN Release
references.scope: Comparative reagent study; DIC/Oxyma has HCN side-reaction, individual alternatives require their own assessment.

references.title: Aspartimide Formation and Its Prevention in Fmoc Chemistry Solid Phase Peptide Synthesis
references.authors: Kong, van den Braak and Neumann
references.scope: Review of Asp-related base-mediated side reactions; no calibrated failure probability for a specific sequence.
